sources.title: Bangladesh
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Mexico's live official traveler guidance expressly addresses Mexican nationals and directs their visa request to Bangladesh's embassy in Mexico.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas SÍ necesitan visa para viajar a Bangladesh.

sources.title: Chad
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Mexico's live official traveler guidance expressly maps Mexican citizens to a visa obtained at Chad's nearest diplomatic or consular representation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La visa debe ser tramitada en la representación diplomática o consular de Chad más cercana.

sources.title: Comoros
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Mexico's live official traveler guidance expressly states that Mexican nationals obtain the visitor visa on arrival at the entry port.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas mexicanas requieren visa para viajar a Comoras y se puede tramitar al arribar al puerto de entrada.

sources.title: Sudan
sources.publisher: Secretariat of Foreign Affairs of Mexico
sources.officialityEvidence: Mexico's live official traveler guidance expressly maps Mexican citizens to a Sudanese diplomatic or consular application route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La visa debe ser tramitada en la representación diplomática o consular sudanesa más cercana.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Bangladesh advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's current traveler guidance directs Mexican visitors to Bangladesh's embassy for visa processing.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican-passport visitor travel; Bangladesh's embassy determines the visa category and duration.
Final admission remains a decision of Bangladeshi authorities.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Chad advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's current traveler guidance requires Mexican visitors to apply at Chad's nearest diplomatic or consular representation.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican-passport visitor travel; the visa is obtained through a Chadian diplomatic or consular representation.
Registration with the National Police is required within three days after entry.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Comoros visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Mexico's current traveler guidance says Mexican visitors request the visa at Comoros' entry port.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican-passport visitor travel; the visa is requested at the entry port for up to 45 days.
A return ticket and hotel reservation are required for the arrival-visa request.

policies.title: Mexican ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Mexico's current traveler guidance requires Mexican visitors to apply at the nearest Sudanese diplomatic or consular representation.
conditions: Ordinary Mexican-passport visitor travel; the visa is obtained through a Sudanese diplomatic or consular representation.
A passport with Israeli entry or exit stamps is refused a Sudanese visa or entry.

conflicts.explanation: Current Mexican government guidance directs Mexican visitors to Bangladesh's embassy for visa processing, rather than documenting a pre-travel electronically issued visitor visa.
